text:
mira (pm): Starting a compact thread for a customer-driven opt-in rollout that prioritizes SLA-aware shedding and "surgical" rollback. Goal: let select accounts test low-bit routing with tight operator controls and surfaced reasons for any auto-divert. I'll keep this short and concrete.

mira (pm): Proposal (high level):
- step A: heartbeat shadow (internal probes + mirror 0.2% traffic) for 8h, validate probes across short/med/long prompts.
- step B: tenant opt-in micro-canary: up to 8 tenants, cap 10rps/tenant, 0.25% global traffic, A/B 1:1, 2h bake then 12h observation.
- step C: cohort widen: add +40 tenants (up to 5% traffic) stratified by tenant size and region, A/B 70/30, 24h observation.
- step D: SLA-aware regional ramp: only increase for gold SLA customers if p95 within 1.5x baseline.

mira (pm): Key novel pieces:
- heartbeat probes: synthetic requests every minute per region to detect systemic latency shifts separately from tenant noise.
- surgical rollback: when quality or infra alerts hit, remove only the offending stratum (prompt-length or tenant-size) rather than full rollback whenever safe.
- explicit reason codes: any auto-divert must attach a reason code (latency_spike, quality_drift, infra_error, cost_overrun) surfaced to CS/tenant dashboard.

ash (eng): +1 on surgical rollback. Infra notes: flags must support per-stratum targeting (e.g., prompt_length=short) and a reason_code enum. Controller will enforce min_sample_count and min_duration before percent increases. We'll also add a "probe_mode" that runs non-billable probes to warm caches.

ash (eng): Implementation constraints: backfill KV cache warming must be rate-limited (default 12rps/tenant) and expose throttling metrics. Also need a dry-run header so CS can preview decisions for a customer in dev.

tomo (sre): Circuit breaker draft: auto-divert a tenant if any of:
- p95 > baseline * 2 for 6m OR
- sustained error delta > 0.35% for 10m OR
- GPU preemptions / OOM in path.
Region auto-divert requires 4 tenants tripping in 20m. When auto-divert happens: set flag state to "auto_divert_<reason>" and page SRE. Manual un-divert only.

lee (data): Metrics gating idea: multilayer checks
- probe signal: heartbeat latency increase > 15% triggers investigation (not immediate divert).
- fidelity: embedding cosine mean >= 0.87 and rerank swap < 3% over 6h window.
- business: CTR change <= 0.4% absolute or posterior probability new < baseline -0.02 < 0.05.
For small cohorts use bootstrap over 6h with min N=1000 impressions per stratum.

jana (cs): Customer ops: add "auto-divert preference" checkbox in consent flow: (auto|manual). If manual, CS gets alerted and will coordinate before un-divert. Also want the reason_code visible in tenant logs + email template for rollback.

mira (pm): Example flag payload we want as a canonical sample (stringified below so infra can parse):
```json
{"name":"prod.ff.routing.optin.lowbit","envs":"[\"staging\",\"prod\"]","default":"false","allowed_tenants":"[\"acct_x\"]","min_sample_count":"1000","min_time_window_mins":"120","warmup_rps_per_tenant":"12","probe_mode":"true","strata":"[\"prompt_short\",\"prompt_long\"]","owner":"mira"}
```

ash (eng): We'll wire the controller to emit stop-reasons if scaling is blocked and to push reason_codes when auto-divert runs. Also adding a small smoke generator that emits stratified traffic so we can validate surgical rollback logic.

tomo (sre): Additions: require a cooldown after auto-divert of 30m before any automated re-enable; manual un-divert must include a short incident summary. We'll also track aggregate cost_delta per-tenant and auto-divert if cost increases by >25% relative to baseline for 1h.

lee (data): For analysis: stratify reports by prompt length, tenant size, region, and time-of-day. We'll publish a 6h quick-check and 24h detailed report. Alert if effect_size > 0.025 on core metric or p_value < 0.01 after correction.

jana (cs): Ops note: we'll show an "insights" card in tenant console when a diversion occurs with reason_code and link to support playbook. Also preparing rollback email templates.

ops-bot: Flag prod.ff.routing.optin.lowbit created in staging at 1999123456.

mira (pm): Action items & ETAs:
- ash: controller + per-stratum flags + probe_mode (ETA Wed)
- lee: gating doc + 6h/24h report templates (ETA Tue)
- tomo: circuit breaker + cooldown + cost-based divert (ETA Thu)
- jana: consent UI + templates + tenant dashboard card (ETA Fri)

mira (pm): If no objections by EOD I'll schedule heartbeat shadow for next Mon and open the PRs. Quick ack thread please.
